summary: Koochiching County, MN: Minnesota Forest Service tower dated 1927; 1959 survey gives 120 ft overall; listed as removed with no date. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: Four-legged steel structure with a metal observation room (1959 survey note); listed as ladder type
facts.status_note: Listed as removed in the county list; no removal date found

events.note: Date given as 1927 in the county and statewide lists, 96 ft ladder type
1959 survey notes describe the steel tower with an observation room, 120 ft overall; the NGS station description places the marker beside the tower

evidence.quote: Minnesota Forest Service, now Mn Department of Natural Resources, Forestry Division

evidence.supports: tower marked as removed, no date given
1959 survey: four-legged steel structure with metal observation room, overall height 120 feet
evidence.quote: observation room at the top. The overall height is 120 feet.

corrections.why: 155N-25W-36 is a township, range and section (T155N R25W, section 36), not an owner. The county and statewide lists name the Minnesota Forest Service (Mn MFS) as owner.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The lists give 96 ft in the height column, while the 1959 survey notes give 120 ft overall. The record uses the 1959 overall height (36.6 m); the list's 96 ft is 29.3 m.
The lists place the tower in section 36, while the 1959 station description places the marker on the east edge of section 35. Not reconciled.

notes_for_editor: The county and statewide lists appear to share the same 1959 survey notes, so they are not independent. Removal is undated in every source read. No source describes the site today. The lists' 96 ft and the survey's 120 ft overall are both quoted in the story.
